extracted.intended_audience: public relations professionals and corporate communicators using press release distribution and AI discovery tools
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for creating press releases optimized for discoverability, citation, and surfacing in AI answer engines and for compliant, targeted distribution across media and financial/regulatory channels.

rubrics_metrics.name: SOAR — Structure
rubrics_metrics.description: One of the four signals in the SOAR Content Framework (Structure, Originality, Authority, Recency) that consistently influence AI visibility.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Make press releases structured so AI can understand and interpret them. SOAR is presented as a blueprint for AI-visible press releases and is intended to ensure news is optimized before it’s measured, tracked, or amplified.

rubrics_metrics.name: SOAR — Originality
rubrics_metrics.description: One of the SOAR signals; Originality is a signal that influences whether AI systems will surface and cite a source.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Position releases to add new, non-duplicative information and distinctive content that increases the likelihood of being cited by answer engines (framework based on a large AI visibility study).

rubrics_metrics.name: SOAR — Authority
rubrics_metrics.description: One of the SOAR signals; Authority affects whether AI trusts and cites a press release.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Build press releases to demonstrate credibility and trustworthiness so AI answer engines will prefer and cite the source. The site frames AI-optimized content as being focused on 'authority and clarity.'

rubrics_metrics.name: SOAR — Recency
rubrics_metrics.description: One of the SOAR signals; Recency influences AI visibility and surfacing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure timely publication and visible timestamps/updates when relevant so AI answer engines treat the release as current and relevant.

rubrics_metrics.name: AI optimization for answer-engine visibility (AI Press Release Optimizer)
rubrics_metrics.description: Use tools that recommend nuanced edits to improve visibility in answer-engine responses and citations; not a simple grade but optimization for authority and clarity in AI-mediated discovery.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The AI Press Release Optimizer 'improves visibility in answer-engine responses and citations by recommending nuanced edits and explaining why they matter.' Emphasized as going beyond surface checks and focusing on changes that raise AI discoverability and citation likelihood.

rubrics_metrics.name: PR basics — headline length, keywords, quotes, links
rubrics_metrics.description: Core technical/content elements commonly checked by typical PR tools: headline length, keywords, quotes, and links.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: GlobeNewswire notes that typical tools check these basics, but their AI Optimizer 'goes further'—so these remain necessary minimum checks (ensure appropriate headline length, relevant keywords, credible quotes, and useful links).

rubrics_metrics.name: AI citation tracking & analytics
rubrics_metrics.description: Track how often press releases are cited and surfaced across AI answer engines (e.g., ChatGPT, Gemini) using analytics that include AI citation data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use analytics (GlobeNewswire Analytics with Profound data) to obtain real-time insight on AI citations; leverage findings (e.g., study of 200,000+ press releases and 13 million AI citations) to iteratively improve visibility, accuracy, and reach of future releases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Targeted media reach (media contacts & Smart Search)
rubrics_metrics.description: Find and connect with the right journalists and media contacts using context and semantic search rather than basic Boolean queries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use Smart Search to uncover relevant journalists traditional searches might miss; pair with Personalized Pitch to avoid mass emails and send smarter, data-informed outreach quickly—improves earned media results by focusing on relevance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personalized pitching
rubrics_metrics.description: Send tailored, personalized outreach instead of mass email blasts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Leverage data-informed 'Personalized Pitch' capabilities to craft targeted pitches; the page emphasizes skipping mass emails to increase engagement with journalists who 'actually cover your story.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Regulatory and earnings-compliant disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure earnings releases and regulatory filings (e.g., 8-Ks, EDGAR, SEDAR) are timely and optimized for visibility across financial markets, search, and AI platforms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow compliance workflows to simplify complex reporting and amplify discoverability; timeliness and correct filing channels/formats are critical for market/regulatory audiences and for downstream AI indexing and citation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Optimized distribution (targets & channels)
rubrics_metrics.description: Distribute press releases targeted by region, industry, or audience and ensure reach across Wall Street terminals, newsroom inboxes, search engines, and AI tools.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use targeted distribution options to get the story 'everywhere it matters'—select regions, industries, or audience segments and ensure the release is discoverable in the relevant platforms and professional terminals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Structure and formatting for multiple consumers (newsrooms, search engines, generative AI)
rubrics_metrics.description: Format and structure content so it is usable by newsrooms, search engines, and generative AI platforms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Craft releases with structured elements (clear headlines, datelines, boilerplate, metadata, machine-readable fields) so they can be discovered, indexed, and amplified by different consumers including AI answer engines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multimedia and SEO enrichment
rubrics_metrics.description: Include built-in multimedia assets and SEO practices to enhance discoverability and engagement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use multimedia (images, video, attachments) and SEO optimization alongside AI discovery tools to increase the likelihood of indexing, linking, and citation across traditional and AI-driven channels.
